subcommands.name: create-signaling-channel
subcommands.description: Creates a signaling channel.

subcommands.name: create-stream
subcommands.description: Creates a new Kinesis video stream.

subcommands.name: delete-edge-configuration
subcommands.description: An asynchronous API that deletes a stream’s existing edge configuration, as well as the corresponding media from the Edge Agent.

subcommands.name: delete-signaling-channel
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified signaling channel.

subcommands.name: delete-stream
subcommands.description: Deletes a Kinesis video stream and the data contained in the stream.

subcommands.name: describe-edge-configuration
subcommands.description: Describes a stream’s edge configuration that was set using the StartEdgeConfigurationUpdate API and the latest status of the edge agent's recorder and uploader jobs.

subcommands.name: describe-image-generation-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the ImageGenerationConfiguration for a given Kinesis video stream.

subcommands.name: describe-mapped-resource-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the most current information about the stream.

subcommands.name: describe-media-storage-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the most current information about the channel.

subcommands.name: describe-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the NotificationConfiguration for a given Kinesis video stream.

subcommands.name: describe-signaling-channel
subcommands.description: Returns the most current information about the signaling channel.

subcommands.name: describe-stream
subcommands.description: Returns the most current information about the specified stream.

subcommands.name: describe-stream-storage-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current storage configuration for the specified Kinesis video stream.

subcommands.name: get-data-endpoint
subcommands.description: Gets an endpoint for a specified stream for either reading or writing.

subcommands.name: get-signaling-channel-endpoint
subcommands.description: Provides an endpoint for the specified signaling channel to send and receive messages.

subcommands.name: list-edge-agent-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns an array of edge configurations associated with the specified Edge Agent.

subcommands.name: list-signaling-channels
subcommands.description: Returns an array of ChannelInfo objects.

subcommands.name: list-streams
subcommands.description: Returns an array of StreamInfo objects.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags associated with the specified signaling channel.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-stream
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags associated with the specified stream.

subcommands.name: start-edge-configuration-update
subcommands.description: An asynchronous API that updates a stream’s existing edge configuration.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to a signaling channel.

subcommands.name: tag-stream
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to a stream.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a signaling channel.

subcommands.name: untag-stream
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a stream.

subcommands.name: update-data-retention
subcommands.description: Increases or decreases the stream's data retention period by the value that you specify.

subcommands.name: update-image-generation-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the StreamInfo and ImageProcessingConfiguration fields.

subcommands.name: update-media-storage-configuration
subcommands.description: Associates a SignalingChannel to a stream to store the media.

subcommands.name: update-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the notification information for a stream.

subcommands.name: update-signaling-channel
subcommands.description: Updates the existing signaling channel.

subcommands.name: update-stream
subcommands.description: Updates stream metadata, such as the device name and media type.

subcommands.name: update-stream-storage-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the storage configuration for an existing Kinesis video stream.
